description: Teaching formulations for the Athanor pyrotechnics laboratory. Compositions are historical reference mixtures used to teach oxygen balance, burn rate and flame colour. They are not manufacturing instructions.

formulations.name: Black Powder (75/15/10)
formulations.notes: The oldest pyrotechnic composition. Burns best when granulated, not as a fine dust.

formulations.name: Strontium Red Star
formulations.notes: Strontium emits at 606 nm. Dextrin is the binder; stars are dampened and rolled.

formulations.name: Barium Green Star
formulations.notes: Barium salts are toxic. The 524 nm line needs a chlorine donor to dominate.

formulations.name: Copper Blue Star
formulations.notes: Blue is the hardest colour: CuCl emits at 590 nm only in a cool flame.

formulations.name: Potassium Perchlorate Whistle
formulations.notes: Whistle compositions are pressed tightly and burn with a resonant gas oscillation.

formulations.name: Titanium White Fountain
formulations.notes: Titanium burns with bright white sparks. Never use fine titanium dust in an open room.
